Sam L: quick bakeoff wrap — ran GPTQ profiles across Llama-3-8B, Mistral-7B, Qwen-7B; focusing on MMLU, HellaSwag, and our internal customer-concat eval.
Jia W: nice. which quant configs?
Sam L: tested: baseline FP16, GPTQ-4bit (per-tensor), GPTQ-4bit-per-channel, AWQ-int8, and our experimental fp8-sim. each on CPU & A100 for latency.
Leo P: throw up the top-line drops?
Sam L: pasted raw summary: 
```
Model         | Config               | MMLU acc | HellaSwag acc | CustEval F1 | Avg latency (token, A100) | Peak GPU mem
Llama-3-8B    | FP16                 | 62.3     | 79.4          | 0.842       | 12ms                      | 5.3GB
Llama-3-8B    | GPTQ-4bit-tensor     | 60.1 (-2.2)| 77.8 (-1.6) | 0.820 (-0.022)| 9.5ms                    | 3.1GB
Llama-3-8B    | GPTQ-4bit-channel    | 61.0 (-1.3)| 78.4 (-1.0) | 0.831 (-0.011)| 10.1ms                   | 3.5GB
Llama-3-8B    | AWQ-int8             | 61.8 (-0.5)| 79.0 (-0.4) | 0.839 (-0.003)| 11.6ms                   | 4.1GB
Llama-3-8B    | fp8-sim              | 61.5 (-0.8)| 78.6 (-0.8) | 0.836 (-0.006)| 10.8ms                   | 3.9GB

Mistral-7B    | FP16                 | 58.4     | 75.2          | 0.798       | 10.7ms                    | 4.6GB
Mistral-7B    | GPTQ-4bit-tensor     | 54.9 (-3.5)| 72.0 (-3.2) | 0.755 (-0.043)| 8.1ms                    | 2.8GB
Mistral-7B    | GPTQ-4bit-channel    | 56.2 (-2.2)| 73.5 (-1.7) | 0.774 (-0.024)| 8.8ms                    | 3.0GB
Mistral-7B    | AWQ-int8             | 57.9 (-0.5)| 74.8 (-0.4) | 0.792 (-0.006)| 9.9ms                    | 3.6GB
Mistral-7B    | fp8-sim              | 57.5 (-0.9)| 74.4 (-0.8) | 0.789 (-0.009)| 9.4ms                    | 3.4GB

Qwen-7B       | FP16                 | 63.8     | 81.0          | 0.861       | 13.2ms                    | 5.6GB
Qwen-7B       | GPTQ-4bit-tensor     | 61.0 (-2.8)| 78.6 (-2.4) | 0.832 (-0.029)| 10.0ms                   | 3.4GB
Qwen-7B       | GPTQ-4bit-channel    | 62.2 (-1.6)| 79.8 (-1.2) | 0.848 (-0.013)| 10.4ms                   | 3.7GB
Qwen-7B       | AWQ-int8             | 63.2 (-0.6)| 80.6 (-0.4) | 0.858 (-0.003)| 12.0ms                   | 4.3GB
Qwen-7B       | fp8-sim              | 62.8 (-1.0)| 80.1 (-0.9) | 0.855 (-0.006)| 11.2ms                   | 4.0GB
```
Jia W: interesting that AWQ-int8 keeps closest to FP16 across the board; latency tradeoffs are modest.
Ana M: did you run spikes for long-context (32k) tokens? KV cache stability?
Sam L: we did 4 long-context spot checks (16k/24k/32k) — GPTQ-4bit-tensor shows KV degradation on Qwen at >20k (generation stalls, minor token mix-ins). AWQ & fp8-sim stable on Mistral/Qwen but Mistral had ~1.5% accuracy jitter at 32k.
Leo P: any eval-bot numbers for instruction following / hallucination rates?
Sam L: eval-bot clipped set: instruction-contradiction rate (lower is better): FP16 0.9%, GPTQ-4bit-tensor 2.6%, GPTQ-4bit-channel 1.7%, AWQ-int8 1.1%, fp8-sim 1.3%.
ops-bot: note: created artifacts at s3://redwood-evals/crossfam/3054321000/ (profiles, quant matrices, raw logs)
Jia W: TL;DR recs for rollout?
Sam L: propose two tracks: 
- Conservative: Mistral-7B + AWQ-int8 (small perf drop, best stability). Canary on Dedicated pool with auto-fallback to FP16.
- Aggressive cost-save: Llama-3-8B GPTQ-4bit-channel for steady latency-sensitive routes; run heavy eval set nightly and enable automatic rollback on >1.5% MMLU regression.
Ana M: add gating: for Qwen-based customer workloads, avoid GPTQ-4bit-tensor for any long-context workflows.
Leo P: can we get a perf profile for Dedicated (p4d vs a100) and CPU fallback?
Sam L: yes. next push will include p4d numbers and sample CPU-only throughput. planning to run sweep tomorrow morning.
Jia W: can you tag the eval notebook? I'll take the HellaSwag failure cases.
Sam L: tagged: @Jia W in the notebook & uploaded failing examples. also added a quick script to reproduce the KV stall: 
```bash
python reproducer/kv_stall.py --model qwen-7b --quant gptq-tensor --context 22000
```
Ana M: thanks — leaning toward AWQ for Mistral and Qwen for now.
Sam L: ok will ship canaries Monday. ping me if you want earlier access. :rocket:
